[Skip to main content](https://supportgowhere.life.gov.sg/schemes/CDA/top-up-child-development-account-cda#main-content) # Top-up to Child Development Account (CDA) - SupportGoWhere Top-up to Child Development Account (CDA) Share link One-off $400 top-up to Child Development Account (CDA) for Singapore Citizens aged 0 to 6 from September 2023. SCHEME HIGHLIGHTS - One-off $400 top-up to Child Development Account (CDA) for Singapore Citizens aged 0 to 6 in 2023 - Top-up will be credited from September 2023 - Eligible child must open a CDA by 30 June 2024 Expand all sections About this support | The SG Child Support Package announced at the 2026 National Day Rally will replace the current Baby Bonus Scheme and Large Families Scheme. Those currently on the Baby Bonus Scheme will be automatically transitioned to the Package. In the meantime, existing payouts will continue as usual.
Learn more about the [SG Child Support Package](https://go.gov.sg/sgchildsupportpackage). | - $400 top-up to Child Development Account (CDA) for Singapore Citizens aged 0 to 6 from September 2023 Who is this for? - Singapore Citizen child born between 1 Jan 2017 and 31 Dec 2023 (both dates inclusive). - Children born on 1 Jan 2017 who have started primary school in 2023 will receive the Edusave top-up instead. - Eligible child must open a CDA by 30 June 2024. How to apply? Eligible child must open a CDA by 30 June 2024. You can open a CDA with DBS Bank, OCBC or UOB. Where can I find help? View more details * * * MSF Consolidated Hotline: [1800 111 2222](tel:18002537707) (say ‘Baby Bonus’ when asked for the hotline you want to reach) Operating hours: Mon to Fri 8.30am to 6pm \| Saturday: 8.30am to 1pm (Closed on Public Holidays) _Airtime charges apply for mobile calls to 1800 service lines_ Overseas: +6562537707 Airtime charges apply for mobile calls to 1800 service lines. Calls are free of charge only if made from regular land lines in Singapore. * * * [Submit an enquiry through Ask Baby Bonus](https://ask.gov.sg/msf/questions/new?topic=MSF%20Baby%20Bonus) Scheme last updated 01 Sep 2026 Try our AI search
